alarms.subject: family:coverage_judge
alarms.why: refused all of its last 8 verdicts across 7 items

gaps.criterion_why: Every part a built in-scope capability ships must be exercised by a scene with a control, and these are concrete, observable claims.
gaps.observed: record.json:26 claims 'broad walkable deep sand, no rain, low fertility, no rivers, allowed roads, disease/weather tables'; its proof_note says presence 'do[es] not establish current coverage, travel cost or appearance'. landscape_route only expects 'desert surfaces resolve and work at defaults'; no scene reads path cost, rain, fertility, rivers, roads or the disease table.

smallest_fix.what: Add a terrain arm to scenes.json landscape_route (start, expect, control) listing these reads; file its entry point under the existing scene item

gaps.what: Terrain capability claims beyond surface appearance are exercised by no scene
gaps.would_pass: An acceptance arm (in landscape_route or package_floor) that, on a generated RM_Stillsand map, reads pawn traversal ticks across RM_DeepSand versus Sand, rainfall over a compressed interval, per-cell fertility, river absence and road permission on the tile, and the active disease incident set, each compared against a control biome map that differs.

gaps.criterion_why: Each is a separate shipped behaviour of a built unit, and a scene can observe it.
gaps.observed: record.json:164 ships 'Oommok mirror giant and aurrok grazer; native giant bodies, stats, kinds and art', but no scene names the aurrok and none checks Oommok's mirror property, stats or art. record.json:282 ships the 'Duumma buried creature', but water_cycle only butchers its sac. record.json:340 lists 'terrain/strike/hit surfacing', but swim_fish_thumper tests terrain and strike only. record.json:264 makes hatching conditional 'when the ProximityHatch service loads', and resident_ecology has no service-absent arm.

smallest_fix.what: Extend resident_ecology and swim_fish_thumper actions/expect/control in scenes.json with these four arms

gaps.what: Creature behaviours named in the inventory are exercised by no scene
gaps.would_pass: resident_ecology (or a new arm) observes a natural aurrok grazing and Oommok's mirror effect and stats against loaded defs, with art checked beside a human. It observes a living duumma's buried state and surfacing. swim_fish_thumper adds a damage-on-submerged-swimmer arm that surfaces it, with an undamaged control. resident_ecology adds a ProximityHatch-absent arm where nizzek eggs do not proximity-hatch and nothing errors.

gaps.criterion_why: What a player reads must agree with what the tree accepts as the behaviour.
gaps.observed: record.json:226: 'described as patient follower; current implementation is ordinary predator AI and slow movement'. resident_ecology only expects 'Gaanok retains its actual slow ordinary predator AI'. Nothing reconciles the player-read description (floor 'text'/'reads_as' applicable) with that behaviour.

smallest_fix.what: Add the description-vs-behaviour check to resident_ecology expect/control; file the text correction as a build item

gaps.what: The Gaanok's in-game description promises behaviour the implementation lacks, and no scene checks the text
gaps.would_pass: A text/reads_as arm reads the loaded Gaanok description and compares its behavioural claims against the observed AI trace. Either it passes because the description no longer claims following, or a filed build item corrects the text, and the arm fails on the current 'patient follower' wording.

gaps.criterion_why: The capability text makes these claims, and an XML-element read plus a lifespan observation can falsify each.
gaps.observed: record.json:110: 'Short-lived unsowable hourbloom is output of pouring and gale seeding rather than an ordinary wild roster resident'. Scenes test only the pour and gale outputs. record.json:70 'no added lush scrub' and record.json:529 'ruukka and oorrik are incident castes rather than ambient residents' have no absence or lifecycle check.

smallest_fix.what: Add the absence/lifecycle reads to resident_ecology or pour_expiry_thumper with a mutant-roster control

gaps.what: Exclusion and lifecycle claims (short-lived, unsowable, not on the wild roster, no lush scrub, castes not ambient) have no scene
gaps.would_pass: One roster/lifecycle arm shows a poured hourbloom dying within its declared lifespan, hourbloom absent from the sowable plant list and from the loaded BiomeDef wildPlants/wildAnimals, ruukka/oorrik absent from the ambient roster, and no lush scrub defs in the patched roster. A control fixture that adds each to the roster is detected.

gaps.criterion_why: Built supplied content ships with the composed package and needs its own exercise.
gaps.observed: record.json:131 'canon bloddle supplied separately by campaign patch', record.json:813 'canon skeletons/graveyard supplied above RM' and record.json:632 'RSW horn item/recipe' appear in no scene. campaign_encounters uses the horn but never crafts it; giant_history covers only ordinary RM conversion.

smallest_fix.what: Add the three campaign-tier arms to campaign_encounters (or resident_ecology/giant_history) in scenes.json

gaps.what: Parts supplied by the campaign or upper tier are not exercised in their supplying tier
gaps.would_pass: Campaign-tier arms: the bloddle patch applies and a bloddle grows or is used, a canon giant corpse converts to its canon skeleton/graveyard, and the RSW horn recipe is completed by an ordinary bill. Each has an RM-only control where the item is absent.

gaps.criterion_why: Two of the four shipped track behaviours have no observation.
gaps.observed: record.json:469 ships 'invisible swim troughs and Oommok prints, erasure on accumulated sand motion through SetDepth/AddDepth and gale wipe'. Scenes test troughs and the gale wipe only; 'prints' appears in scenes.json only inside 'fingerprints'.

smallest_fix.what: Add the Oommok-print and dune-motion erasure arm to swim_fish_thumper or shade_landmarks

gaps.what: Track prints and non-gale erasure are untested
gaps.would_pass: An arm where a walking Oommok leaves prints read from the TrackGrid and captured, and accumulated dune motion (no gale) via SetDepth/AddDepth erases a trough or print, with a stationary-sand control that keeps it.

gaps.criterion_why: These are stated behaviours with an obvious plausible alternative (calling every swimmer).
gaps.observed: record.json:406: 'calls submerged non-player swimmers; reachable destinations, radius overlays'. The controls cover dry thumper and an unreachable destination, but no player-owned swimmer control and no placement or selection overlay capture.

smallest_fix.what: Add the player-owned swimmer control and an overlay capture to swim_fish_thumper

gaps.what: Thumper radius overlay and non-player call filter are untested
gaps.would_pass: A tamed or player-faction submerged swimmer in range is not called by a charged thumper while a wild one is, and the placement/selection radius overlay is captured matching the wet radius.

gaps.criterion_why: A gate that only toggles cannot show a claimed scaling.
gaps.observed: record.json:896 ships 'stat-part work-speed scaling and outdoor/temperature penalty cancellation'. workshop_jobs only interrupts and resumes work. record.json:613 ships 'elevation scaling ... and own base/top art', but giant_visit fires in one arm with clear/shade lanes and checks no art.

smallest_fix.what: Add the paired-intensity stat reads to workshop_jobs and the two-elevation and art arms to giant_visit

gaps.what: Sun-scaled numeric effects of the sun tables and sun lance, and the lance's art, are not measured
gaps.would_pass: workshop_jobs reads the work-speed stat at two sun intensities and with outdoor/temperature penalties present versus cancelled, matching the stat-part. giant_visit fires the lance at low and high elevation and records damage scaling. The lance base/top textures resolve and are captured beside a human.

gaps.criterion_why: A start assertion is not an exercise of the capability.
gaps.observed: record.json:853 ships 'traded fine sand' and a 'guarded canon krayt lens remains a trade prize'. workshop_jobs mentions the krayt lens only in start ('optional canon krayt-lens trade route'); no action trades, and fine sand trade is absent.

smallest_fix.what: Add a trader arm to workshop_jobs or resident_ecology (which already generates a Vaalok trader)

gaps.what: Trade routes for glass materials are only asserted, never exercised
gaps.would_pass: A trader generated on Stillsand stocks fine sand, and in the campaign tier the krayt lens appears as a trade prize and is bought. An RM-only control lacks the lens, and nothing errors when the guard is off.

gaps.criterion_why: Both are concrete, observable effects of a built unit.
gaps.observed: record.json:1156 ships 'launch restriction and weather penalties'. gale_phases covers phases, mass flux, senses and emergence; 'launch' occurs nowhere in scenes.json.

smallest_fix.what: Add launch and penalty reads to gale_phases action/expect/control

gaps.what: Gale launch restriction and weather penalties are untested
gaps.would_pass: During a gale a shuttle/transport launch order is refused with a reason and succeeds in the quiet sibling. The weather's move-speed/accuracy/work penalties are read from pawn stats in gale versus quiet.

gaps.criterion_why: The owner's ruling is numeric and names the vanilla consumer, and an observation can check both.
gaps.observed: tree.json:134 promises 'the ruled 55 C zenith value and ordinary air heat'. sun_geometry only 'Record[s] the ruled 55 C zenith input' and expects 'geometry determines exposure and its heat contribution', with no numeric relation and no felt-temperature/Heatstroke read. record.json:1089 also ships 'shared shade/pathing', and no scene observes pawns pathing through shade.

smallest_fix.what: Add the numeric expectation, the heatstroke consumer read and a shade-pathing arm to sun_geometry

gaps.what: Direct Sun's ruled magnitude, its vanilla heat consumer and legacy shade pathing are not asserted
gaps.would_pass: sun_geometry asserts the Direct Sun contribution equals 55 C x sin(sun angle) within a stated tolerance at the low and high lanes, and roofed/parasol lanes read zero. It shows the pawn's felt temperature and Heatstroke severity rising in the open lane and not in the roofed lane at matched air temperature. A shade-pathing arm shows a pawn's chosen path through available shade versus open ground.

gaps.criterion_why: The contract defines hold as whether the scene stays up for his review, and these leaves declare his review.
gaps.observed: tree.json:73 'owner_part': 'yes: inspect the expedition route and apparent emptiness' (similarly :98, :124, :387), yet every scene in scenes.json has 'hold': 'immediate' and none names the capture set or held save he reviews. The flagship showcase built from these scenes is meant for him to judge.

smallest_fix.what: Set hold or add a named review-output field on those four scenes in scenes.json

gaps.what: Leaves whose owner part is 'yes' end at once with no review output named
gaps.would_pass: Each of landscape_route, harbour_secured, fortune_supply and walk_accept has either hold 'owner_review' with a scene-hold condition, or names the keeper savegame/capture packet produced for his review (per the savegame-options rule), so a script can confirm the review artifact exists.

gaps.criterion_why: The judge brief requires the sheet a player reads to say what the tree tests.
gaps.observed: sheet.md:17 says current water capabilities 'retain their full coverage'. sheet.md:19 says giant history 'keep[s] their distinct ownership'. sheet.md:15 says encounters 'complete their warning, action and consequence routes'. These are process words a player cannot read as play. Giant remains drying into skeleton landmarks, glass/lens/sun-cooking work, the Muurrok beam and take, and the stillsand_walk leaf (tree.json:371; only in pruning at sheet.md:65) have no 'does' line.

smallest_fix.what: Rewrite sheet.md does lines for current_water, giant_history, giant_encounters and ordinary_work, and add a stillsand_walk line

gaps.what: The player sheet describes process instead of what the tree tests, and omits the walk and central capabilities
gaps.would_pass: Every tree leaf (including stillsand_walk) has a 'does' line stating the observable play outcome its scenes test (e.g. 'a dead giant dries into a species skeleton landmark; titan meat spoils like meat'), with no 'coverage'/'ownership'/'routes' process words. A fresh reader can map each line to its leaf's expect.

gaps.criterion_why: A floor line claiming an evidence mode needs a scheduled observation that can produce it.
gaps.observed: floor.json memory 'establishes' bounds by 'Short repeated create/use/clear/reload cycles', and save_size by 'repeated compressed wet/incident/corpse cycles'. package_floor collects them only 'when the respective controlled route is scheduled', and no scene names those cycles or their counts.

smallest_fix.what: Name the measurement cycles and their scenes in package_floor's action/expect

gaps.what: Floor evidence modes rely on cycles that no scene schedules
gaps.would_pass: package_floor (or a named floor scene) lists the concrete create/use/clear/reload and wet/incident/corpse cycles, their repetition counts and the scene that runs each, with a same-list baseline control, so a script can match each floor line to a scheduled measurement.

reasons: Not covered: 14 gaps, all `first` and all Designer-fixable (return_to 3). Every leaf and the scope of every inventory unit have an acceptance scene that is script-staged, with asserted starts, controls and restoration. But many individual shipped parts have no scene. Uncovered: terrain claims (deep-sand travel, rain, fertility, rivers, roads, disease); the aurrok grazer, Oommok mirror/stats/art, buried duumma, hit surfacing and the ProximityHatch-absent arm; the Gaanok description mismatch; hourbloom and roster exclusion claims; campaign-supplied bloddle, canon skeletons and horn recipe; Oommok prints and dune-motion track erasure; the thumper's non-player filter and overlay; sun-table and sun-lance scaling and lance art; glass trade routes; the gale launch restriction and penalties; the Direct Sun 55 C x sin numeric assertion, heatstroke consumer and shade pathing. Owner-part leaves have only 'immediate' scenes with no review output. The sheet is written in process words and omits the walk. Floor cycles are unscheduled. Removed capabilities have absence checks under their OWNER cuts. Note for a neutral fixer, not a gap: the contract says showcase 1's decision is 'speaker owner', but d_flagship_pick is a Conductor Evidence-for-Ask delegation. Later standing rulings (Conductor authority, Evidence-for-Ask) authorize that, so the contract's wording appears stale.
